# Scopebond

> Scopebond is an open-source checkpoint for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, MCP,
> GitHub) that blocks out-of-policy actions before they run and signs every decision into
> a tamper-evident record anyone can verify offline. Open source (Apache-2.0), self-host
> free, records verify with no account and no network.

This repository is the open-source product. The hosted workspace ("Scopebond Cloud") is
a separate, proprietary product and is not here.

## What it is
Scopebond checks every action a coding agent takes — a shell command, a file edit, a git
push, an MCP tool call — against rules you write, blocks the ones that break them, and
signs a tamper-evident `scopebond:receipt` (Ed25519) for every decision. Cooperative
(in-path on the developer's machine) for Claude Code, Cursor and MCP; a required check
(gated) for agent pull requests on GitHub.

## Packages (npm @scopebond/*)
- @scopebond/hook — Claude Code + Cursor connector. `npx @scopebond/hook init` (add --cursor for Cursor).
- @scopebond/github-action — required policy check that fails an out-of-policy agent pull request.
- @scopebond/mcp — proxy that checks every MCP tools/call against your policy.
- @scopebond/framework — in-process guard for Vercel AI SDK, LangGraph and more.
- @scopebond/gateway — self-hosted policy-enforcement checkpoint over HTTP/MCP, with a kill switch. `npx @scopebond/gateway init`.
- @scopebond/verify — deterministic `violates(policy, receipts, claimed)` and conformance vectors.
- @scopebond/policy-schema — the policy vocabulary and receipt envelope as JSON Schema.
- @scopebond/sdk — Ed25519 operator signing.

## Roadmap
OpenAI Codex, cloud runtimes and business platforms are released one at a time. See https://scopebond.com/roadmap.

## What a valid signature proves
Integrity and provenance for what the signer asserted. It does not by itself prove an
external effect, completeness or compliance.
